caption:
Need a team? Find clubs across Miami-Dade and Broward, follow the ones you like, sign up for a tryout and hear back from the coach. That's your team. Those are your people. ⚽

The Cancha app is coming to the App Store. Join the waitlist: link in bio. 📲

App preview: the screens are illustrations of the upcoming app. Club crests shown with each club's okay.

#MiamiSoccer #BrowardSoccer #SouthFloridaSoccer #FindYourTeam #Cancha
altText: Cancha app preview: club crests land on a map of Miami-Dade and Broward, River Miami FC's card opens, Follow and Sign up for tryout are tapped, a coach's message says 'We want you on the team', and a team chat welcomes the player. Ends on 'Find your team. Find your people. Join the waitlist.'
